verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

trs.20: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."
trs.85: We sent Noah to his people: ‘Warn your people, before a painful punishment comes to them.’
trs.22: We sent Noah to his People (with the Command): "Do thou warn thy People before there comes to them a grievous Penalty."
trs.203: Verily, We sent Nûh (Noah) to his people (saying): "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful torment."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

trs.20: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner -
trs.85: And so he said, ‘My people, I am here to warn you plainly.
trs.22: He said: "O my People! I am to you a Warner, clear and open:
trs.203: He said: "O my people! Verily, I am a plain warner to you,

verses.text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ

trs.20: To worship Allāh, fear Him and obey me.
trs.85: Serve God, be mindful of Him and obey me.
trs.22: "That ye should worship Allah, fear Him and obey me:
trs.203: "That you should worship Allâh (Alone), fear (be dutiful to) Him, and obey me,

verses.text_uthmani: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

trs.20: He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allāh, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew."
trs.85: He will forgive you your sins and spare you until your appointed time––when God’s appointed time arrives it cannot be postponed. If only you understood!’
trs.22: "So He may forgive you your sins and give you respite for a stated Term: for when the Term given by Allah is accomplished, it cannot be put forward: if ye only knew."
trs.203: "He (Allâh) will forgive you of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Verily, the term of Allâh when it comes, cannot be delayed, if you but knew."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا

trs.20: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
trs.85: He said, ‘My Lord, I have called my people night and day,
trs.22: He said: "O my Lord! I have called to my People night and day:
trs.203: He said: "O my Lord! Verily, I have called to my people night and day (i.e. secretly and openly to accept the doctrine of Islâmic Monotheism),<sup foot_note=155009>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا

trs.20: But my invitation increased them not except in flight [i.e., aversion].
trs.85: but the more I call them, the further they run away:
trs.22: "But my call only increases (their) flight (from the Right).
trs.203: "But all my calling added nothing but to (their) flight (from the truth).

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا

trs.20: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments,<sup foot_note=197620>1</sup> persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
trs.85: every time I call them, so that You may forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, cover their heads with their garments, persist in their rejection, and grow more insolent and arrogant.
trs.22: "And every time I have called to them, that Thou mightest forgive them, they have (only) thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, grown obstinate, and given themselves up to arrogance.
trs.203: And verily, every time I called unto them that You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, and persisted (in their refusal), and magnified themselves in pride.

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا

trs.20: Then I invited them publicly.
trs.85: I have tried calling them openly.
trs.22: "So I have called to them aloud;
trs.203: "Then verily, I called to them openly (aloud).

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا

trs.20: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
trs.85: I have tried preaching to them in public and speaking to them in private.
trs.22: "Further I have spoken to them in public and secretly in private,
trs.203: "Then verily, I proclaimed to them in public, and I have appealed to them in private.

verses.text_uthmani: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا

trs.20: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
trs.85: I said, “Ask forgiveness of your Lord: He is ever forgiving.
trs.22: "Saying, 'Ask forgiveness from your Lord; for He is Oft-Forgiving;
trs.203: "I said (to them): ‘Ask forgiveness from your Lord, verily, He is Oft-Forgiving;

verses.text_uthmani: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا

trs.20: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
trs.85: He will send down abundant rain from the sky for you;
trs.22: "'He will send rain to you in abundance;
trs.203: ‘He will send rain to you in abundance,

verses.text_uthmani: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَـٰرًا

trs.20: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
trs.85: He will give you wealth and sons; He will provide you with gardens and rivers.
trs.22: "'Give you increase in wealth and sons; and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers (of flowing water).
trs.203: ‘And give you increase in wealth and children, and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers.’"

verses.text_uthmani: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا

trs.20: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allāh [due] grandeur
trs.85: What is the matter with you? Why will you not fear God’s majesty,
trs.22: "'What is the matter with you, that ye place not your hope for kindness and long-suffering in Allah,-
trs.203: What is the matter with you, that [you fear not Allâh (His punishment), and] you hope not for reward (from Allâh or you believe not in His Oneness).

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا

trs.20: While He has created you in stages?<sup foot_note=197621>1</sup>
trs.85: when He has created you stage by stage?
trs.22: "'Seeing that it is He that has created you in diverse stages?
trs.203: While He has created you in (different) stages [i.e. first Nutfah, then ‘Alaqah and then Mudghah, see (V.23:13,14)].

verses.text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا

trs.20: Do you not consider how Allāh has created seven heavens in layers<sup foot_note=197622>1</sup>
trs.85: Have you ever wondered how God created seven heavens, one above the other,
trs.22: "'See ye not how Allah has created the seven heavens one above another,
trs.203: See you not how Allâh has created the seven heavens one above another?

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا

trs.20: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
trs.85: placed the moon as a light in them and the sun as a lamp,
trs.22: "'And made the moon a light in their midst, and made the sun as a (Glorious) Lamp?
trs.203: And has made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا

trs.20: And Allāh has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
trs.85: how God made you spring forth from the earth like a plant,
trs.22: "'And Allah has produced you from the earth growing (gradually),
trs.203: And Allâh has brought you forth from the (dust of) earth? (Tafsir At-Tabarî)

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا

trs.20: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.
trs.85: how He will return you into it and then bring you out again,
trs.22: "'And in the End He will return you into the (earth), and raise you forth (again at the Resurrection)?
trs.203: Afterwards He will return you into it (the earth), and bring you forth (again on the Day of Resurrection)?

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا

trs.20: And Allāh has made for you the earth an expanse
trs.85: and how He has spread the Earth out for you
trs.22: "'And Allah has made the earth for you as a carpet (spread out),
trs.203: And Allâh has made for you the earth a wide expanse.

verses.text_uthmani: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا

trs.20: That you may follow therein roads of passage.'"
trs.85: to walk along its spacious paths?” ’
trs.22: "'That ye may go about therein, in spacious roads.'"
trs.203: That you may go about therein in broad roads.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا

trs.20: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.
trs.85: Noah said, ‘My Lord, they have disobeyed me and followed those whose riches and children only increase their ruin;
trs.22: Noah said: "O my Lord! They have disobeyed me, but they follow (men) whose wealth and children give them no increase but only Loss.
trs.203: Nûh (Noah) said: "My Lord! They have disobeyed me, and followed one whose wealth and children give him no increase but loss.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا

trs.20: And they conspired an immense conspiracy
trs.85: who have made a grand plan,
trs.22: "And they have devised a tremendous Plot.
trs.203: "And they have plotted a mighty plot.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا

trs.20: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwāʿ or Yaghūth and Yaʿūq and Nasr.'<sup foot_note=197623>1</sup>
trs.85: saying, “Do not renounce your gods! Do not renounce Wadd, Suwa, Yaghuth, Yauq, or Nasr!”
trs.22: "And they have said (to each other), 'Abandon not your gods: Abandon neither Wadd nor Suwa', neither Yaguth nor Ya'uq, nor Nasr';-
trs.203: "And they have said: ‘You shall not leave your gods: nor shall you leave Wadd, nor Suwâ‘, nor Yaghûth, nor Ya‘ûq nor Nasr’ (these are the names of their idols).

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَـٰلًا

trs.20: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
trs.85: They have led many astray. Lord, bring nothing but destruction down on the evildoers!’
trs.22: "They have already misled many; and grant Thou no increase to the wrong-doers but in straying (from their mark)."
trs.203: "And indeed they have led many astray. And (O Allâh): ‘Grant no increase to the Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers, and disbelievers) save error.’"

verses.text_uthmani: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًا

trs.20: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers.
trs.85: They were drowned and sent to Hell for their evildoings: they found no one to help them against God.
trs.22: Because of their sins they were drowned (in the flood), and were made to enter the Fire (of Punishment): and they found- in lieu of Allah- none to help them.
trs.203: Because of their sins they were drowned, then were made to enter the Fire. And they found none to help them instead of Allâh.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا

trs.20: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
trs.85: And Noah said, ‘Lord, do not leave any of the disbelievers on the earth-
trs.22: And Noah, said: "O my Lord! Leave not of the Unbelievers, a single one on earth!
trs.203: And Nûh (Noah) said: "My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers on the earth!

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا

trs.20: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
trs.85: if you leave them they will lead Your servants astray and beget only sinners and disbelievers-
trs.22: "For, if Thou dost leave (any of) them, they will but mislead Thy devotees, and they will breed none but wicked ungrateful ones.
trs.203: "If You leave them, they will mislead Your slaves, and they will beget none but wicked disbelievers.

verses.text_uthmani: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا

trs.20: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
trs.85: Lord, forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house as a believer. Forgive believing men and women but bring nothing but ruin down on the evildoers!’
trs.22: "O my Lord! Forgive me, my parents, all who enter my house in Faith, and (all) believing men and believing women: and to the wrong-doers grant Thou no increase but in perdition!"
trs.203: "My Lord! Forgive me, and my parents, and him who enters my home as a believer, and all the believing men and women. And to the Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers, and disbelievers) grant You no increase but destruction!"
